The teacher asked him what his name was. (Indirect Speech)

The teacher said to him, "What is your name?" (Direct Speech)

The tense of the Indirect Speech is in the Past indefinite tense. So, the tense in the Direct Speech will be in the Present indefinite tense.

The complete sentence is: The officer is to be court-martialled upon his arrival.

Note:

A Preposition is a word placed before a noun or a pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition) and shows a relationship in space or time or a logical relationship between two or more people, places, or things in a sentence.

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The power of narratives in cultural diplomacy lies in their ability to transcend geopolitical boundaries, fostering a deep understanding and appreciation of diverse cultures.

B. Narratives, whether in the form of literature, film, or art, possess the unique capacity to convey the intricacies of a society's values, history, and collective identity.

D. Through storytelling, individuals from different corners of the world can connect on a human level, recognizing shared emotions and universal themes.

questions.solution:
Sentence A introduces the central idea of the power of narratives in cultural diplomacy, emphasising its ability to transcend geopolitical boundaries and foster understanding of diverse cultures.

Sentence B follows by elaborating on the various forms of narratives, such as literature, film, or art, and highlights their unique capacity to convey the intricacies of a society's values, history, and collective identity.

Sentence D builds on the concept of narratives by emphasising storytelling as a means for individuals from different parts of the world to connect on a human level. It points out that through storytelling, people can recognise shared emotions and universal themes.

Sentence E introduces the strategic aspect of harnessing narratives, stating that when used strategically, narratives become potent instruments for breaking down stereotypes, dispelling misconceptions, and promoting empathy.

Finally, sentence C concludes the paragraph by emphasising the role of narratives as bridges between cultures. It states that narratives allow for the exchange of ideas and the celebration of shared humanity, reinforcing the idea that they serve as powerful tools in cultural diplomacy.

So, the correct order is ABDEC. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

Collective responsibility is the cornerstone of the parliamentary system of government. In India, this principle is enshrined in Article 75(3) of the Constitution, which states that the Council of Ministers shall be collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha (the lower house).

It means that the Government must maintain a majority in the Lok Sabha as a condition of its survival.

The collective responsibility under Article 75 of the Constitution of India has two meanings:

(I) All members of a Government are unanimous in support of its policies,

(II) The ministers, who had an opportunity to speak for or against the policies in the cabinet are thereby personally and morally responsible for its success and failure.

What it means in practice:

Unanimity: Once a decision is taken in a Cabinet meeting, it becomes a joint decision of the entire Council of Ministers.

Public Support: Every minister is duty-bound to support and defend that decision both inside and outside Parliament. A minister cannot criticize a government decision in public.

Resignation: If a minister disagrees with a Cabinet decision and is not prepared to defend it, he or she must resign. A famous example is Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's resignation due to differences over the Hindu Code Bill.

"Swim or Sink Together": If the Lok Sabha passes a No-Confidence Motion against the Council of Ministers, the entire ministryincluding ministers from the Rajya Sabhamust resign.

The IOD can occur independently of an El Nio or La Nia event, and their combined effect on the Indian monsoon can be complex. For instance, a strong positive IOD can sometimes mitigate the drought-inducing effects of an El Nio.

Article 143 of the Constitution of India grants the President the power to consult the Supreme Court. This power is known as the Advisory Jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.

The article specifies two categories of matters on which the President can seek the Supreme Court's opinion:

-On any question of law or fact of public importance that has arisen or is likely to arise. In this case, the Supreme Court may or may not tender its opinion to the President.

-On any dispute arising out of any pre-constitution treaty, agreement, covenant, sanad, or other similar instruments. In this case, it is obligatory for the Supreme Court to tender its opinion to the President.

In both cases, the opinion expressed by the Supreme Court is only advisory and not a judicial pronouncement. Hence, it is not binding on the President.

Assertion (A): An increase in repo rate may reduce inflation (True)

The Repo Rate is the interest rate at which the central bank (like the RBI in India) lends money to commercial banks. It is the primary tool used in Contractonary Monetary Policy to control rising prices (inflation).

When inflation exceeds the target range, the central bank raises the repo rate to "cool down" the economy.

Higher rates discourage excess spending and investment, which leads to a decrease in the general price level over time.

Reason (R): It increases borrowing cost and reduces money supply (True)

This statement correctly identifies the transmission mechanism (how the change actually works):

Cost of Funds: When the repo rate increases, it becomes more expensive for commercial banks to borrow from the central bank.

Passing the Cost: Banks pass this increased cost to their customers by raising interest rates on home, car, and personal loans.

Reduced Liquidity: As borrowing becomes costlier, people and businesses take fewer loans. This directly reduces the money supply (liquidity) circulating in the market.

Lower Demand: With less money in hand and higher EMIs, consumer demand for goods and services drops. When demand falls, the pressure on prices eases, thereby reducing inflation.

Even when a body moves in a circle at a constant speed, its velocity is constantly changing. This is because velocity is a vector quantity that includes both speed and direction. As the object moves along the circular path, its direction of motion changes at every single point.

Since acceleration is defined as the rate of change of velocity, a change in direction-even without a change in speed-results in acceleration. This specific type of acceleration is called Centripetal Acceleration.

The word "centripetal" literally means "center-seeking." The acceleration vector always points perpendicular to the velocity vector.

-It is always directed toward the center of the circle.

-Without this inward acceleration, the object would fly off in a straight line (along the tangent) due to inertia.

In the Indian Census, literacy rates are calculated in two ways: Crude Literacy Rate and Effective Literacy Rate.

1. Crude Literacy Rate

This is calculated by taking the total number of literate persons and dividing it by the total population of the country. This includes infants and toddlers who are biologically and developmentally too young to read or write.

2. Effective Literacy Rate

To get a more accurate picture of a country's educational progress, the "effective" rate is used.

-It is calculated by dividing the number of literate persons by the population aged 7 years and above.

-Therefore, the entire population in the 0-6 age group is excluded from the denominator, as children in this group are treated as illiterate by default in the census, regardless of whether they can read or write.

The Address Bus in a computer system is unidirectional, not bidirectional. It is used by the CPU to specify the memory address of the data or instruction it wants to read from or write to. The flow of information (the address) is always from the CPU to the memory and I/O devices. The CPU dictates the address; it does not receive addresses from other components via the address bus. The Data Bus, on the other hand, is bidirectional, as data needs to flow both from memory to the CPU (read operation) and from the CPU to memory (write operation).

Ctrl + K (Hyperlink): This is a universal shortcut across Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. It opens a dialog box allowing you to link selected text or objects to a website, a file, or a specific place in your current document.

An optical storage device uses light-specifically lasers-to read and write data on a reflective disc. This technology is fundamentally different from magnetic or electronic storage.

How it Works: Pits and Lands

The surface of an optical disc like a DVD contains billions of microscopic bumps called pits and flat areas called lands.

-Reading: A low-power laser beam is shone onto the spinning disc. When the light hits a "land," it reflects back cleanly to a sensor. When it hits a "pit," the light scatters. The sensor translates these changes in reflection into binary data (0s and 1s).

-Writing (Burning): For recordable DVDs (DVD-R), a high-power laser physically "burns" or chemically alters a layer of the disc to create non-reflective spots that mimic pits.
